text: R-05's scheduled audit runs. Hartwell's independent compliance team scopes it precisely: standing admin access to the OT and SCADA segment, as of a stated cutoff date.

The method is documented and specific: export membership of OT-SCADA-Admins in Entra ID and its AWS counterpart group ot-scada-admins, de-duplicate, and count. That's the entire method -- group membership, nothing else.

As of the close of business on October 12, the audit reports 14 accounts holding standing admin access to the OT and SCADA segment. It's a clean, defensible number, produced by a completely normal audit method.

Hold onto three things: the number 14, the method -- group membership only -- and the date, October 12. The next lesson measures the exact same access, the exact same day, and gets a different answer.
